data.name: Frightful Presence
data.description: If you have performed your daily obedience, you have looked into oblivion, and its horrors are reflected in your eyes. You can terrify foes as a free action whenever you take an offensive action, such as attacking. Foes within 30 feet of you and with fewer Hit Dice than you must succeed at a Will saving throw or become shaken for %1 rounds equal to your Hit Dice (DC %2). If the victim has 4 or fewer Hit Dice, it becomes panicked instead. Foes with more Hit Dice than you are immune to this ability.|TL|10+TL/2+CHA
